channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Asia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Asia, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Ubah Rumah Residency 2027/2028 (Nikoi Island, Indonesia; Southeast Asian artists) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Ubah Rumah
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: Artist fee (figure not published), accommodation and a round trip within Southeast Asia.

A residency on Nikoi Island focused on art, ecology and hospitality. ELIGIBILITY: artists from or based in Southeast Asia. OFFER: an artist fee (amount not published), accommodation and a round trip within Southeast Asia, for a stay of four to six weeks in 2027 or 2028.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Frankfurt Moves! Frankfurt LAB Residency Stipend 2027 (closes 7 Dec)
item.description:
Frankfurt LAB and KfW Stiftung
Deadline: 7 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 2,750 gross stipend per person (EUR 2,000 for the Frankfurt month, EUR 750 for the remote month), plus four weeks of accommodation, round-trip travel to Frankfurt and up to EUR 800 for artistic work expenses per person or team. No application fee.

Frankfurt Moves!, an initiative of KfW Stiftung run with the Frankfurt LAB (the production space shared by Ensemble Modern, Dresden Frankfurt Dance Company, Hessische Theaterakademie, HfMDK Frankfurt and Mousonturm), offers four two-step residencies for emerging performing artists, solo or in teams...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Sixi Museum: SIXI AiR Open Call 2027 Spring & Autumn (Nanjing)
item.description: Sixi Museum · deadline 15 Nov 2026 · Round-trip flights, visa application fees, insurance, and a private city-center apartment or loft studio on the outskirts, plus a material allowance (amount not published), technical assistance, airport pickup and translation support. NO artist fee or stipend mentioned. No application fee.

item.title: Making Space Residency 2027 for Netherlands-Based Practitioners (Guangzhou)
item.description: Making Space, in partnership with the Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in China · deadline 03 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,700 travel and artist fee subsidy (fixed per application; duos or collectives share it), plus accommodation in Guangzhou and shared studio space

item.title: Khoj x Mozilla Foundation: Counterstructures Residency 2026 (Delhi)
item.description: Khoj International Artists' Association in collaboration with Mozilla Foundation · deadline 13 Sep 2026 · Mozilla's Creative Futures: Counterstructures programme publishes USD 2,500 per resident (USD 2,000 stipend plus a USD 500 materials budget), along with weekly in-person work sessions, guest lectures from practitioners across art, technology and community design, and publication of the finished project in the collective documentation report. CAVEAT: neither the Khoj call page nor the Mozilla application form restates a figure for this six-week Delhi edition, and the published package covers the ten-week format, so confirm the amount with Khoj before applying. No application fee.
